title: Head of Quality
text:
Vaco has partnered with Ypsomed USA during a pivotal stage of its North American expansion to identify a
**Head of Quality/QA**
who will play a key leadership role in building and scaling the U.S. organization.
 
 

**Head of Quality/QA USA**

Ypsomed is a leading Swiss medical technology company specializing in the development, manufacture, and supply of innovative injection systems for self-medication. With our solutions, we enable people worldwide to administer their medication safely, conveniently, and independently.

As Head of QA USA, you will play a key role in establishing and leading the Quality organization at our US location. You will build a strong quality culture, ensure regulatory compliance and manufacturing readiness, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to enable the safe, reliable, and sustainable supply of our products. In this leadership role, you will shape the quality strategy from the ground up and contribute directly to the successful growth of our site.

**Your Main Tasks:**

* Define and implement the Quality strategy and organization for the US site in close alignment with corporate functions, ensuring manufacturing readiness from the outset.
* Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing local Quality team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure the site Quality Management System is established, maintained, and continuously improved in compliance with corporate standards, FDA requirements, ISO 13485, MDSAP, Pharma GMP, and relevant combination product expectations.
* Provide senior Quality leadership for complex site-level issues, ensuring sound risk assessment, effective escalation, and timely decision-making.
* Oversee core Quality processes including nonconformance management, CAPA, change control, risk management, process validation, and internal/external audits.
* Ensure strong Quality oversight across industrialization, incoming materials, manufacturing, release-related activities, and ongoing operations to support compliant and efficient product supply.
* Partner closely with Corporate Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to embed Quality requirements into transfers, implementation activities, and operational readiness.
* Act as the primary US Quality contact for audits, inspections, and external assessments, while driving inspection readiness and continuous improvement of local processes, systems, tools, and templates.

**Your Profile**

* University degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical/Medical Engineering, Pharmacy, Quality Management, or a related field; alternatively, a technical background with additional quality management certification.
* 10+ years of progressive Quality experience, including leadership responsibility, within medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or combination products in regulated manufacturing environments.
* Deep expertise in Quality Management Systems and applicable regulations, including FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, MDSAP, Pharma GMP, and combination product requirements.
* Proven experience building and leading high-performing Quality teams, ideally in a start-up, scale-up, site-build, or fast-growing manufacturing environment.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as FMEA, SPC, DMAIC, 8D, 5 Why, and Lean Six Sigma; Green or Black Belt certification is an advantage.
* Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and resilient leader with strong communication and stakeholder management skills, international collaboration mindset, and ideal experience in high-volume manufacturing, automation and plastic molding for injection systems.
